title: Gandhi begins the Salt March
summary: Mohandas Gandhi set out from Sabarmati Ashram with 78 followers on a 24-day walk to Dandi on the coast to make salt in defiance of the British salt tax.
reason: The salt tax was a symbol of British rule that hurt every Indian, making it an ideal target for civil disobedience.
significance: It drew world attention to the Indian independence movement and launched a mass civil disobedience campaign.
